promise: One photo → a few seconds of viral effect, on 100% open weights.
ledeEffects: Pick an effect on the wall, add a photo, then Generate.
ledeCamera: A photo and a camera move give a 5 s clip: the dashed frame shows where the camera ends.
ledeFilm: Chain two or three camera moves on one photo into a film of 10 to 15 s.
ledeAvatar: A photo and a text: the photo says it, in English or French.
ledeMotion: A photo and a reference video: the person in the photo performs its motion.
hooksHint: Effects animate your photo as it is. Hooks first edit it into an end frame, then animate the way there.
remixHint: Opens this move as a YAML file: change its speed, poses or text, check it, then render your version.
t2iNeedsText: Describe the photo to create it.
editNeedsPhoto: Add a start photo to edit it.
editNeedsText: Say what to change to edit the photo.
editNeedsConsent: Tick the consent box to edit this photo.
catalogFailed: The camera moves could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
tierQualityHint: Follows the move exactly, pose by pose
tierTurboHint: The same moves in 4 steps: a little less detail
tierFastHint: Follows the move from its text only
profile12Note: 12 GB profile: Quality (20 steps) needs a 24 GB card
leaveHint: You can leave this tab: the clip goes to History when it is ready.
promptPlaceholder: e.g. a fishing harbour at golden hour, a wooden boat at the dock, houses on the hill
sceneWhy: Without this text, the model invents what it cannot see and the clip turns ghostly.
sceneNeeded: Describe what the photo shows to generate.
samplePhotoScene: a quiet fishing harbour at golden hour, a weathered wooden boat in the foreground, colourful houses on a green hillside
sampleSubjectScene: a golden retriever sitting on the grass of a park
samplePortraitScene: a woman with short brown hair in a grey t-shirt, against a grey wall
sampleCharacterScene: a cartoon boy in a green jacket and a red scarf, full length, on a light background
failed: The render failed. Try again; if it fails again, the server log says why.
lost: The render was lost when the server restarted. Generate again.
remixTooLarge: This preset is larger than 16 KB.
localNote: Runs on your GPU or a GPU you rent. Nothing leaves your machine.
openStackIntro: Every model Montagio can run, grouped by what it makes, is open weights under Apache-2.0 or MIT, and no closed API sits in the render path. This page shows the latest automated check, weight file by weight file.
openStackSdk: Built on the Comfy SDK (@comfyorg/sdk) and comfy-api-proxy, both installed with Montagio: they send the Studio’s ComfyUI workflows to a ComfyUI on the same machine, never to a hosted service.
openStackNodePack: The Montagio node pack for ComfyUI (GPL-3.0): Montagio Camera Embedding runs two camera moves in one Wan 2.2 Fun Camera clip, and Load Montagio Preset turns a preset file into the inputs of a graph.
openStackUnavailable: The latest check could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
stackPhoto: Photo: text to image and edit
weightSource: Source repository, where the licence was read: {url}
noViolations: No violation: no partner node, no closed API, no restricted weight.

errorBackendUnavailable: The ComfyUI server cannot be reached. Check that it is running, then try again.

sequenceHint: Pick 2 or 3 camera moves, in order.
shotsFull: Three shots already: remove one to add another.
shotPromptPlaceholder: Optional: what happens in this shot

errorShowcaseRemix: The showcase does not render remixes. Run Montagio on your machine to generate this one.
errorNotInShowcase: This combination is not in the showcase.
errorFfmpegUnavailable: FFmpeg could not start in this browser, so the film cannot be assembled here. Single clips still work.
errorMontageBusy: A film is already being assembled.
showcaseNote: This online showcase plays clips pre-generated with Montagio on open weights ({model}, {license}). To animate your own photo, run Montagio on your machine.
showcaseHdCaption: Pre-generated with Montagio · {model} ({license}) · in HD by {hd} ({hdLicense}) · AI-generated
showcasePlaceholderCaption: Placeholder: camera move simulated by FFmpeg until the GPU session, not a model output.
showcaseRemixNote: Your remix is checked here for real. The showcase does not render: run Montagio on your machine to generate it.
showcaseSequenceNote: In this showcase every shot starts from the sample photo. Run locally, each shot starts on the last frame of the previous one.
showcasePromptLocal: Locally, you describe your own photo here.
showcaseSubjectLocal: What the photo shows applies when you generate locally.
showcaseFooter: Showcase: pre-generated clips · No account, no cookie, no analytics: Montagio collects nothing
showcasePlaceholderNote: Some clips are still placeholders: FFmpeg simulates their camera move until the GPU session renders them.
demoCaption: Demo render: no model ran here. With a GPU, {model} ({license}) makes it.

demoMovedCaption: Demo render: FFmpeg moves the photo, no model ran here. With a GPU, {model} ({license}) makes it.
errorBlockedName: This text names a well-known person. Montagio does not make images of real people without their consent.
errorConsentRequired: Tick the box to confirm you are the person in this photo, or that you have their consent.
errorExtensionDisabled: This feature is not available on this installation.
errorInvalidInput: This request cannot be rendered. Check the text and the options, then try again.

hookEndFrame: End frame · AI-generated · {model} ({license}). The clip follows.

avatarTooShortHint: This may last under 1 s, the least an avatar animates: write a longer text.

motionRights: I hold the rights on this video and on this photo
motionNeedsVideo: Add a reference video to generate.
motionNeedsRights: Confirm your rights on the video and the photo to generate.
avatarNeedsText: Write what the avatar says to generate.

showcaseT2iNote: These images were pre-generated with {model} ({license}). Run Montagio locally to write your own text.
showcaseT2iPick: The texts of the sample photos

repriseNoPhoto: The photo of this creation is gone: pick a new one.
exploreTitle: One photo in. A clip out.
exploreLead: Camera moves, viral effects, talking avatars and motion transfer, on open weights only, on your own GPU. No account, no credits.
exploreFeatCameraText: Eleven cinematic moves on any photo: push, pull back, pan, crane, drift.
exploreFeatEffectsText: Squish it, blow it up, slice it into cake: one photo, five seconds.
exploreFeatHooksText: A two-step transformation: the edit draws the end frame, the video model gets there.
exploreCameraText: Pick a move, describe the photo, get a clip.
exploreEffectsText: Six one-photo effects and the hooks, on one wall.
exploreFilmText: Chain two or three moves into a film, with music.
exploreAvatarText: A photo and a text become a talking clip, in English or French.
exploreMotionText: Your character copies the moves of a reference video.
exploreT2iText: No photo yet? Write one, with camera and light controls.
exploreEditText: Change the photo in plain words, or pick a look.
exploreHdText: Any clip, upscaled to 1080p on your GPU.
exploreMusicText: An instrumental track made for your film.
exploreComfyText: Download the exact workflow behind any clip.
exploreStack: Every model here is open weights, licensed Apache-2.0 or MIT, and checked on each start. No closed API, no partner node.
exploreCharactersText: A person, a frog or a robot of your own: made once, then its photodump, then animated anywhere.
charactersLead: Make a fictional character from a few words, a person, a frog, a robot or an alien, place it in new scenes with a photodump, then send any picture to a camera move, an effect, an avatar or a motion transfer.
charactersShowcase: Characters run in the app installed on your machine: this free demo plays clips rendered beforehand.
characterFictional: A character is fictional: it comes from a text, never from a photo of someone.
characterDetailsPlaceholder: a woman in her thirties, short silver hair, red bomber jacket, black jeans
characterDetailsPlaceholderKind: a yellow raincoat, round glasses, a big cheerful smile
characterDeleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Its pictures stay in the history.
photodumpLead: The same character in new places: pick the scenes, one picture each.
photodumpNeedsEdit: The photodump needs the photo edit extension.
inpaintHint: Paint over what should change: only that area is edited, the rest of the photo stays exactly as it is.
maskCanvasLabel: Paint over the area to change
maskUploadFailed: The painted area could not be sent: try again.
voiceHint: 5 to 20 s of clear speech, one speaker, no music: the avatar speaks in that voice.
voiceFailed: This file could not be read as a voice sample (3 s at least).
voiceConsent: This is my voice, or the speaker agreed to this use
inpaintNeedsPaint: Paint the area to change first.
composeLead: Two or three photos put together in one scene first, then the effect plays on it. The location gives the frame.
composeCharacterHint: Who is in the scene: a photo, or one of your characters.
composeLocationHint: Where it happens: a place, a room, a landscape.
composeProductHint: What they hold or what stars: a bottle, a shoe, a phone.
composeUploadFailed: This photo could not be added.
composeNeedsTwo: Add two photos at least to compose the scene.
composeReadyHint: {n} photos: the scene is composed first, then the effect plays (a few seconds more).
exploreAdsText: A product, a style, an effect: a 9:16 ad with music, ready to post.
adsLead: A product photo, a character if you like, a style and an effect: Montagio stages the scene, animates it, writes its music and cuts it to 9:16 with your tagline.
adsNeedsExtensions: The ad studio needs the photo edit, the effects and the music extensions.
adProductHint: A clear photo of the product: a bottle, a shoe, a phone.
adCharacterHint: Someone who presents it: a photo, or one of your characters.
adNeedsProduct: Add a product photo to start.
adEmpty: Your ad will play here, in 9:16, with its music.
adCaption: Made with open weights, marked AI-generated in the file.
drawLead: Sketch the shot, say what it is: the edit turns the drawing into a photo, then animate it with a camera move or an effect.
drawWhatPlaceholder: e.g. a red car on a coastal road at sunset
drawConsent: This drawing is mine, and it shows no real person without their consent
drawNeedsDrawing: Draw something on the sheet first.
drawNeedsConsent: Tick the box above to go on.
exploreVoiceText: A video or an avatar and a voice sample: the same words, in another voice.
voiceChangeLead: The words, the rhythm and the picture stay; only the voice changes, to the voice of a sample its speaker agreed to lend.
voiceChangeNeedsExtension: The voice change needs the avatar extension.
voiceVideoHint: A clip where someone speaks: MP4, WebM or MOV, 50 MB at most. The first 30 s are kept.
voiceVideoFailed: This file could not be read as a video with sound (50 MB at most).
voiceRights: I hold the rights on this video, and the people who speak in it agreed
voiceNoAvatar: No avatar yet: make one in the Avatar tab, then come back.
voiceSampleHint: 5 to 20 s of clear speech, one speaker, no music: the clip speaks in that voice.
voiceChangeNeeds: Add a clip and a voice sample, then tick the boxes.
voiceChangeResult: The clip, in its new voice
voiceChangeEmpty: Your clip will play here, in its new voice.
moodboardHint: Optional: add up to {n} reference pictures. The picture takes their colors, light and mood, not their content.
moodboardTextTooLong: With a moodboard the text holds 300 characters at most.
moodboardNeedsConsent: Tick the consent box: a reference shows a photo you imported.
paletteFromPhotoHint: The edit takes the colors of this photo, nothing else.
exploreCommunityText: Creations with the settings that made them: remix one in a click, share yours as a settings file.
communityLead: Creations shown with the settings that made them. Remix one in a click; publish yours from the History, then send its share file. No account and no server: a share file holds the settings, never your photos.
communityLeadShowcase: Clips really rendered with Montagio, each with its settings: remix one in a click. Run Montagio on your machine to publish your own and share them.
communityImportHint: A .montagio-share.json file someone sent you: its settings join your gallery.
communityImportFailed: This file is not a Montagio share file.
communityMineEmpty: Nothing published yet: publish a creation from the History.
communityRemoveConfirm: Take “{title}” out of the gallery? The History keeps the creation.
communityPublishNote: The gallery keeps a copy and its settings. Its share file sends the settings only, never your photo.
exploreTranslateText: A talking clip said again in another language, in the same voice, the lips following the new words.
translateLead: The same clip in another language: the speech is heard and translated, said again in the same voice, and the face is animated again so that the lips follow the new words.
translateConsent: The person shown agreed to be shown speaking another language, in their own voice
translateNeeds: Add a clip, pick a language, then tick the boxes.
translateEmpty: Your clip will play here, in its new language.
recipeHint: Workflow, weights, seed and versions: everything to make it again.
recipeHonesty: Same recipe, same stack: identical result on the same setup, very close elsewhere (diffusion is not always bit-exact from one graphics card to another).
recipeDemo: Demo render: no model ran here; this is the recipe that renders it with a GPU.
recipeFailed: The recipe could not be loaded. Open it again to retry.
recipeSame: Same workflow and same input files as the original.
recipeDiffers: The workflow differs from the original: other choices, or another version of Montagio.
recipeSameWorkflow: Same workflow as the original; its input files could not be compared.
recipeOtherInput: Same workflow, on other input files: the result differs.
captionsIntro: Burned in word by word, ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.
captionsTextHint: Fix a word and it keeps the moment it is said.
captionsDemo: Demo: these timings are spread over the voice, not heard by Whisper.
captionsUnsupported: Captions are not available for this language yet.
captionsNoSpeech: This clip has no voice to caption.
